name: decky-proton-pulse
description: Decky plugin that ranks ProtonDB reports by system compatibility and applies launch options.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && node scripts/sync-changelog.mjs --sync-unreleased && node scripts/sync-missing-translations.mjs && node scripts/check-translations.mjs --no-fail && node scripts/check-ui-strings.mjs --no-fail && node scripts/check-scoring-sync.mjs && rollup -c
scripts.coverage:check: pnpm test:coverage && UV_CACHE_DIR=${UV_CACHE_DIR:-${HOME}/.cache/uv} UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=${UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE:-system} uv run --group dev python -m pytest tests --cov=main --cov=lib --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=json:coverage/python/coverage.json --cov-report=xml:coverage/python/coverage.xml

author: mdeguzis
